name: Yanagi Bakuto
source:
The benevolent and laid-back leader of the Shinonome-gumi

He might come across as someone who handles everything half-heartedly, but when it's time to get things done, he delivers.

His unpredictable and bold actions often annoy those around him, but at the same time, they rely on him for his ability to get things done.

Part of the Shinonome-gumi
